_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/po-wo.jsx (POList L12-205 · WOList L280-431) + forms.jsx (POCreateForm L140-257 · WOCreateForm L268-...) + the ds.jsx STATUS labels (L83-90) the prototype's <StatusBadge> renders. Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in the .tsx/.ts source — same pattern as gr-strings.json / boq-strings.json. navPoList / navWoList are the 'ใบสั่งซื้อ (PO)' / 'ใบสั่งจ้าง (WO)' nav_i18n labels (tn(): breadcrumb crumb-2, NAV-ROUTES.md L30-31). Every other value is a phrases key (tp()) that has NO dedicated po.*/wo.* dict key (those DICT keys cover the rest of the screen and are used via t()). status* are the four ds.jsx STATUS.<status>.label strings the draft/pending/approved/rejected state machine renders. All confirmed present in i18n-full.json phrases.
